​Why Choose Mr. Tattoo Hanoi When Searching for a Tattoo Near Me?

​Address: 2nd Floor, 106 Hang Buom Street, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi, Vietnam

​2. English-Speaking Artists & Effortless Communication

​3. International Hygiene & Safety Standards

​Hospital-grade sterilization: Full barrier protection on equipment, medical disinfectants, and clean workstation prep for every single client.

​Specialty Tattoo Styles Available at Mr. Tattoo Hanoi

​If you are looking for an expert artist specialized in specific techniques, our talent covers a broad spectrum of modern and traditional tattooing styles:

​Fine-Line & Minimalist Tattoos

Perfect for first-timers, travel souvenirs, or subtle geometric dotwork. Fine-line tattooing requires extreme precision and steady handwork to deliver crisp, delicate lines that heal beautifully over time.

​Blackwork & Dotwork

​From bold dark silhouette work to intricate stippling and dotwork shading, our blackwork art transforms bold contrast into captivating visual textures.

​Traditional Asian & Oriental Motifs

​Immerse yourself in Asian culture with custom dragons, koi fish, lotus flowers, and classical mythology, designed with authentic flow and dynamic composition tailored to your body anatomy.

​Custom Cover-Ups & Restoration

​Have an old, faded, or unwanted tattoo from years past? Our artists specialize in clever cover-up designs, turning old ink into fresh, artistic masterpieces that you will wear with pride.
